messages:
Elaine: Quick preflight — QBR for Cobalt Health is tomorrow. Can someone post a final credits/spend snapshot (30d) + 90d forecast? Need token burn trends, top-5 endpoints by cost, and any active budget alerts. cc @Omar @Mike :eyes:

Nora-bot: Report generated for Cobalt Health — https://redwood.internal/reports/cobalt/preflight-1719997777 (30d spend, 90d linear forecast, anomaly flags).

Omar: grabbing per-route breakdown now. Will post embeddings vs generation split. ETA ~10m.

Sophia: For renewal-risk triage, quick ask: mark HIGH if 90d forecast exceeds remaining committed balance, MED if between 50-100%, LOW otherwise. I'll use that rubric in the QBR slide.

Mike: Quick numbers from my side: committed monthly = $18,000; annual commit remaining balance = $40,000. 30d actual tokens = 2.3B (~$7.2k), linear 90d = $21.6k. Preliminary risk = MED. Will validate pricing tiers (quantized models vs fp32) — might change cost calc.

Omar: posted breakdown (summary):
- generation: 68% of cost (mostly /v1/generate/chat)
- embeddings: 22% (heavy batch jobs)
- reranking & batch-ops: 10%
Top endpoints by cost: /v1/generate/chat, /v1/embed, /v1/rerank, /v1/batch-embed, /v1/summarize.

Omar: raw command I ran to reproduce the snapshot:```sh
rwdctl reports snapshot --account=cobalt --days 30 --format=json > cobalt-30d.json
rwdctl forecast burn --account=cobalt --horizon 90 --method=linear > cobalt-90d.json
rwdctl metrics route-cost --account=cobalt --top=10 > cobalt-route-cost.csv
```

Sophia: Noted a spike on 2025-03-12: embedding throughput doubled due to a newly-deployed webhook that batch-inserts customer vectors. Recommend temporary caching and rate-limit at the ingestion step.

Mike: Proposed automated guardrail: create a budget-alert when rolling 7-day spend rate > 1.5x historical baseline and set an escalation to CSM + Finance. I created a draft alert rule: budget-alert/cobalt/preflight-1719997777.

Nora-bot: Alert created — budget-alert/cobalt/preflight-1719997777. Trigger: rolling_7d_rate > 1.5 * baseline. Notifications: #customer-success, finance-oncall, cobalt-owners. Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1720000012

Elaine: Action items (assigning):
- Omar: attach per-route token histogram and suggest caching threshold (due: in 30m).
- Mike: assemble a one-page ops playbook: throttle strategy (20% degrade), quota change procedure, and billing note for renewal conversation (due: in 2h).
- Sophia: slide for QBR: (1) spend chart (30d & 90d forecast), (2) top endpoints, (3) recommendation & ask (due: EOD).
I will own stakeholder pre-brief and the deck.

Omar: on it. I also recommend a short-term mitigation: move bulk embed jobs to off-peak window and enable per-request dedupe for identical vectors — should cut embedding spend ~35%.

Mike: Confirmed playbook skeleton in Google Drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/Cobalt-ops-playbook — will populate with runbook steps and cost numbers.

Sophia: I'll include a small eval: compare output quality at current model vs quantized variant for top-3 generation routes. If quality delta < 2% we can propose quantized rollout to reduce cost.

Elaine: Perfect. Final note: let's do a 30m sync before the QBR to rehearse the cost slides and escalation language. Meeting invite sent for 30 minutes prior. Thanks team :pray:

Nora-bot: Snapshot archive: s3://redwood-reports/cobalt/preflight-1719997777.tar.gz (retained 14 days).
